messages:
Ivy (Marketing): Quick ask - need a 1-page battlecard and 3 SDR hooks for the benchmark + webinar next week. Can we keep it very short?

Rex (Growth): Yes. One-punch headline + 3 proof bullets + CTA. Test two email variants: percent vs no-percent.

Dana (Product): Bench highlights: RAG 28% cost delta, p95 220ms vs 320ms. Chat 18% cost delta, p95 90ms vs 140ms. Use those as proofs.

Marta (Sales): SDR hooks need to be one liners. My suggestions:
- "Cut real inference spend 20-30% — 30m pilot"
- "Keep p95 latency under 250ms during spikes"
- "Migration plan + usage credit in 2 weeks"

Ivy (Marketing): Nice. I'll draft battlecard front: claim, three bullets (how, proof, CTA), and 3 rebut lines.

bench-bot: Bench deck uploaded: https://drive.redwood/bench/quick_v3.pdf

Rex (Growth): Inbound routing rule: if message contains 'cost' route to Growth; 'latency' -> Solutions; 'on-prem' -> AE-enterprise. Auto-reply asking for workload type.

Dana (Product): Rehearsal Friday 9am PT for the live demo. Will show baseline -> routing -> fallback.

Marta (Sales): I'll prepare the SDR email templates and a short slide for pilot terms.

Ivy (Marketing): Perfect. I'll post the 1-pager draft here by EOD for quick sign-off."
